microros_wifi_connect.message0: connect micro-ROS over WiFi SSID %1 password %2 Agent IP %3 Agent port %4
microros_wifi_connect.tooltip: Connects WiFi and sets the micro-ROS Agent address (blocks until WiFi is connected; use in setup only)

microros_node_init.tooltip: Creates the allocator, rclc support and default node (halts on failure); must run before creating publishers/subscribers

microros_publisher_create.message0: micro-ROS create publisher %1 message type %2 topic %3
microros_publisher_create.tooltip: Creates a best-effort publisher on the node (halts on failure); requires node init first

microros_publish.tooltip: Publishes one message with an existing publisher; the value type must match the publisher message type

microros_subscriber_create.message0: micro-ROS create subscriber %1 message type %2 topic %3 on message %4
microros_subscriber_create.tooltip: Creates the subscriber, its executor and callback (inner blocks run on new messages); requires node init first

microros_subscriber_data.tooltip: Reads the latest received message data (numeric types return a number, String returns text); typically used inside the subscription callback

microros_spin_some.message0: micro-ROS process new messages of %1 wait ms %2
microros_spin_some.tooltip: Checks the subscriber for new messages and fires the callback (place in the loop)

microros_udp_test.message0: micro-ROS UDP connectivity test target IP %1 target port %2
microros_udp_test.tooltip: Send 5 UDP test packets to the target address and print each result (for diagnosing network/firewall issues; use in setup)
